findings.finding: Most of the 23 catalog identities remain snapshot-only, pending-source, rights-uncleared or parity-unverified. The matrix correctly labels these as non-dispatchable, but its values remain pinned to the 2026-11-23 catalog snapshot.
findings.disposition: Regenerate the matrix after catalog changes and require child-source, license, parity, named-host and real invocation evidence before dispatch.

findings.finding: The five configured HSO sources were enabled but not_configured. The PR #26 event-ingestion workflow job can complete successfully while skipping signed event delivery because HSO_SYNC_URL and HSO_SYNC_TOKEN are absent; the scheduled-reconciliation job was also skipped.
findings.disposition: Do not claim HSMART-to-HSO synchronization. Configure exact authorized endpoint/secret and prove a signed event delivery plus reconciliation with resulting sync-run/snapshot evidence.

findings.finding: Security Advisor reported public.rls_auto_enable() callable by anon and authenticated as SECURITY DEFINER. Documentation records the warning but does not remediate it.
findings.disposition: Require owner-approved privilege restriction or SECURITY INVOKER redesign, role-negative tests and a clean follow-up Security Advisor.

findings.finding: KM 0 and KM 1 exit remain unresolved; PC-007 is open and hard-blocks KM 2. Draft PRs and their passing tests do not satisfy the complete KM 1 exit evidence bundle.
findings.disposition: Keep the documented gates open until exact evidence is assembled and the sole designated human authority records the decision.

findings.finding: HSO PR #25 remains a draft with a unit-test mismatch and failed deployment status for the HSO project. Mission Control's separate Vercel success does not repair that failure.
findings.disposition: Resolve the exact compatibility-matrix expectation and inspect the failed deployment on the same HSO commit before approving the architecture change.
